note: Registry of third-party organizations JVTO refers to. The @id base is the JVTO domain on purpose: the @id identifies *JVTO's reference to* the entity, not the entity itself. Ownership is asserted through sameAs. Never add a sameAs URL without verifying it — leave it empty and mark evidenceStatus 'candidate' instead. A node with an @id and no sameAs is still far better than an anonymous node, because the @id is what consolidates the entity across pages. A description field was added 2026-08-19 for records where jvto-web externalEntities.ts had one (hpwki, bbksda-jatim) — leave absent elsewhere rather than fabricating.

records.canonicalName: Balai Besar KSDA Jawa Timur (BBKSDA Jawa Timur)
records.sourceNote: Regulator of TWA Ijen and issuer of SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024, the regulation behind the mandatory health screening. It existed only as a fragment of the string 'HPWKI — supervised by BBKSDA Jawa Timur' and had no node of its own, despite being JVTO's most load-bearing authority asset. No sameAs in the repo yet. Defined on /verify-jvto/legal rather than the health-screening page: it is reached only through HPWKI's regulator relation, and defining it on a page that never names it left a dangling @id. No Wikidata entry found for this regional conservation unit as of 2026-08-19 (a technical implementation unit under Ditjen KSDAE, not independently notable) — left unassigned rather than guessed. Official site verified live, matches URL already used elsewhere in this repo (buildVerifySchemas.ts references). Updated 2026-08-21: the previously listed https://bbksdajatim.org no longer resolves (nor does tiket.bbksdajatim.org, the ticket portal the 2024 circular names), while an unrelated control URL returns 200 — so the failure is real, not a bot block. Replaced with the Ministry of Forestry's TWA Kawah Ijen page, which is live and is where the crater access rules and ticketing now sit.

records.sourceNote: Provider of the founder's Tourist Police commission, rendered in the GovernmentService node's provider slot. Not among the nine entities the specification listed, but found by the same audit: it was the last Organization-class node still emitting without an @id. Its URL was already present in police-authority source data. Corrected 2026-08-21: this record was keyed 'ditpamobvit' and named 'Direktorat Pengamanan Objek Vital (Ditpamobvit)'. Sprin/4954/XI/2020 appoints the founder Polisi Pariwisata Bondowoso via Polres Bondowoso; 'Ditpamobvit' (a Polda-level directorate) appears in none of the 14 archive PDFs. The only 'Pamobvit' in the archive belongs to a different officer on the same order. The old alias was removed rather than kept for matching, because it names an institution this credential never came from.
